# centrifuge-js vendor bundle

- Package: `centrifuge`
- Version: `5.7.0`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/centrifugal/centrifuge-js>
- License: MIT
- Local file: `centrifuge.js`

Run `npm run realtime:sync` after changing the package version. The browser
client only connects to Centrifugo with short-lived credentials issued by the
authenticated Webman API. It cannot publish Wikist business messages directly.
